title: R-Align: Enhancing Generative Reward Models through Rationale-Centric Meta-Judging

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Generative Reward Models (GenRMs) using a new metric called Spurious Correctness (S-Corr), which measures the fraction of correct preference decisions that are justified by superficial formatting features (e.g., the presence of bullet points) rather than valid semantic reasoning or core content quality.

Implementing a strict, dynamic length penalty during Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) training, which penalizes the reward signal if the generated response length exceeds a specific threshold relative to the reference answer, preventing the model from exploiting the reward model's preference for longer text.
